title: A Flexible Fairness Framework with Surrogate Loss Reweighting for Addressing Sociodemographic Disparities
reasoning: The paper focuses on algorithmic fairness and sociodemographic disparities (such as gender and education level) in general machine learning models. While it cites philosophical concepts like Rawlsian justice and the Idea of Justice to motivate the work, it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, faith, spiritual traditions, or moral/ethical reasoning as a primary component.
